52% Back Ukraine Arms, 42% Say Germany Has Gone Too Far, Deutschland Poll Finds — A majority of Germans still support arms deliveries to Ukraine, though 42% say Berlin is going too far. Meanwhile, 56% see Russia as a major threat to Germany, with older voters particularly concerned.

Germany Records 165 Suspected Sabotage Cases This Year — German authorities registered more than 165 suspected sabotage cases nationwide through the end of August, according to a confidential police assessment. Investigators recorded 112 espionage-related crimes and opened 24 espionage cases.

Meloni Breaks Italy’s Post-War Political Record — Giorgia Meloni’s government has become Italy’s longest-serving administration since Mussolini, marking a rare period of political stability. Meloni now faces rising living costs, coalition disputes over defence, tensions with Donald Trump, and pressure from Italy’s nationalist right as she prepares for the 2027 election.

Ukraine to Introduce Two-Level Air Raid Alert System as Drone Attacks Disrupt Daily Life — Ukraine is overhauling its air raid alert system as relentless Russian drone attacks disrupt daily life. Russian Conscripts Increasingly Blocked From Leaving Country Amid Mobilization Fears — Russian conscripts are increasingly being blocked from leaving the country, even as Putin dismisses fresh mobilization reports as an “information attack.” Dozens have been stopped at Russian and Belarusian borders amid growing speculation that Moscow is preparing for another mass call-up.

Russia Changes Strategy: Non-Stop Alerts in Kyiv — Russia has shifted its attacks on Kyiv to prolonged drone bombardments, aiming to exhaust Ukraine’s air defences and disrupt civilian life. Ukrainian Drones Hit Sochi Oil Depot, Air Defense Systems as Moscow Faces Third Night of Flight Disruptions — Ukrainian drones attacked Sochi overnight, setting fire to a Rosneft oil depot and reportedly hitting Russian S-300/S-400 air defenses.
